Register For UPSC Prelims Decision Making Workshop: https://shorturl.at/aLZKR

The 7-Layer Decision-Making Framework for UPSC Prelims | AIR 100

Clearing UPSC Prelims is not just about knowing the right answers. It is also about making the right decisions during the examination — what to attempt, how to approach unfamiliar questions and when to avoid unnecessary risks.

In this free live workshop, Sattwik Satyakam Devta (AIR 100, UPSC CSE 2025) shares his approach to solving the Prelims paper through a structured 7-Layer Decision-Making Framework.

Having cleared UPSC Prelims in all six of his attempts, Sattwik brings valuable experience in understanding how to approach the examination with greater clarity and confidence.

What will you learn in this workshop?

- Understand the 7-layer attempt framework used by UPSC toppers.
- Develop the right mindset and approach for UPSC Prelims.
- Learn how to make better decisions while attempting questions.
- Understand how to apply a decision-making framework during mock tests.
- Build your own personalised exam strategy for UPSC Prelims.

Workshop Details:

📅 Date: 17th November 2026 (Tuesday)  
⏰ Time: 5:00 PM  
💻 Mode: Online  
🎙️ Speaker: Sattwik Satyakam Devta | AIR 100, UPSC CSE 2025

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 or a future attempt, this workshop will help you move beyond simply preparing for questions and start preparing for the decisions you need to make in the examination hall.
